newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain budget talks in tough moment - Catalan leader.
newsitem.headline: Spain budget talks in tough moment - Catalan leader.

text.p: Spanish budget talks were going through a difficult period, Catalonian leader Josep Antoni Duran i Lleida told a Spanish radio station on Tuesday.

"The budget talks with the government are really going through a tough time. This was logical and so we have mentioned it because we recognise the complexity of this budget. But there is one main issue, principally that of the financing of the health budget," Duran i Lleida said.
Duran i Lleida is the leader of the Unio Democratica de Catalunya, one of the affiliates of the Spanish government's allies in Convergencia i Unio.
"In the talks on the budget we don't like this one day this, one day that approach. It's an approach that moves us backwards," Duran i Lleida said.
What is happening is the budget talks are losing credibility in the public eye at a time when the public's faith is most needed," he said.
